meta.title: Phononspeak — agent voice
meta.description: Local Czech-first voice for DeepSeek Harness: reads answer summaries aloud and calls you back to the computer.

settings.title: Phononspeak
page.title: Agent voice
page.subtitle: Local speech, no cloud and no API key. This page controls what is read, how it sounds, and where it plays.
page.offlineHint: The plugin host is not answering. The queue is paused; last known settings are shown until the connection returns.
status.title: Status
status.enabledHint: When off, the agent stays silent and nothing is queued.
voice.title: Voice
voice.noVoices: No voice matches this engine and language.
reading.title: What gets read
reading.autoSummary: Read a summary after every answer
reading.autoSummaryHint: When on, the model sends a 1–3 sentence summary after each answer and the plugin reads it. When off, only explicit tool calls speak.
reading.maxCharsHint: 100–1200. Longer text is shortened and the shortening is announced.
reading.notifyHint: Send a macOS notification together with an attention call.
reading.systemPlaybackHint: Use the system player when the tab is hidden or closed. When off, hidden tabs stay silent.
reading.dndHint: Local time. Leave both empty to disable the quiet window.
privacy.title: Privacy and rights
privacy.commercialHint: Refuse engines whose output cannot be used commercially. Turn this off only for personal, non-commercial work.
privacy.allowPersonalWarning: macOS `say` output is licensed for personal, non-commercial use only. By enabling it you acknowledge you may not publish or commercially use the output.
privacy.localHint: Text is synthesized locally. No audio or text is uploaded; the only network traffic is between this page and the local plugin host.
engines.title: Engines & models
engines.none: The host has not reported any engines yet.
engines.pocketNote: Pocket TTS Czech (vvolhejn/pocket-tts-czech) is CC-BY-4.0; attribution belongs to ÚFAL. Voice cloning is opt-in and works only from a recording you have the right to use.
engines.sayNote: macOS `say` is personal, non-commercial only. It needs the explicit opt-in in Privacy and rights.
clones.title: Cloned voices
clones.intro: Only the pocket engine can clone. Use your own voice, or a voice for which you have written consent.
clones.note: A clone is a reference to a local wav file; the file is never uploaded.
clones.name: Name
clones.path: Absolute path to a wav file
clones.pathMustBeAbsolute: The path must be absolute (it must start with /).
clones.rights: I have the right to use this voice
clones.rightsRequired: Confirm the rights before adding a voice.
overlay.attentionHint: A decision is waiting. The call repeats until you answer.
overlay.systemHint: The desktop player owns this job; the browser stays silent.
overlay.blocked: Autoplay was blocked. Start it here.
tool.kind.question: question
